About us

Articulate Global, LLC, is the leading SaaS provider of creator platforms for online workplace training. Founded by Adam Schwartz in 2002, Articulate provides creator tools and services that make it simple for enterprises and SMBs to develop, deliver, and analyze online workplace training that’s engaging and effective.  Increasingly, organizations must reskill employees for ever-changing remote and hybrid work environments, create learning cultures that attract and retain employees in a tight labor market, and use training to build more equitable, empowering, and engaging workplaces. Articulate helps organizations address these critical business needs with its creator platform for workplace training. Articulate 360—a suite of creator tools for online courses—was named the 7th most-loved product in the world by TrustRadius in 2021. And Rise—an all-in-one online training system that makes online training easy to create, enjoyable to take, and simple to manage—is the first creator platform for SMBs and departments within the enterprise. Articulate has more than 118,000 customers in 170 countries and counts all 100 of the Fortune 100 companies as customers.

Named one of Inc. Magazine’s Best Workplaces 2022 and a leader in building a human-centered organization, Articulate is guided by a commitment to provide the best value to customers, do right by employees, and create an equitable, empowering workplace for all. As a human-centered organization, we honor people’s humanity knowing that each person’s unique history, vulnerabilities, and social location inform how we show up with one another. We embrace our connectedness, aware that what we do and say impacts others. We give each other grace because we are all works in progress, learning and evolving every day. And we take responsibility for ourselves and are serious about our accountability to each other.  In all we do, we strive to create an equitable, sustainable, and empowering workplace while we drive results for the business and make a positive impact in the world. Read more about our values here.

descriptionPlain:
Articulate is seeking a Director of GTM Strategy, Planning & Analytics to lead and evolve how we translate company strategy into actionable go-to-market plans, measure business performance, govern the data foundations that support decision-making, and align compensation programs to GTM priorities across Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Channel.
This role leads an integrated function spanning GTM strategy and planning, forecasting and performance management, analytics and insights, GTM data strategy and governance, and compensation strategy and analytics.
The Director will own the end-to-end GTM planning system, translating company growth objectives into targets, capacity and resource plans, forecasts, performance frameworks, and operating rhythms. The role will ensure GTM leaders have clear, decision-ready insights into business performance, risks, opportunities, and tradeoffs.
The Director will also provide leadership for GTM data strategy and governance, ensuring that the business logic, metric definitions, data standards, and cross-system requirements underlying GTM decision-making are scalable, consistent, and trusted. In partnership with centralized Data, Engineering, IT, and other teams, this role will establish GTM priorities and requirements while those technical organizations retain responsibility for technical architecture and development.
As the leader of this function, the Director will define priorities and operating models, develop managers and senior individual contributors, and partner closely with GTM, Finance, Data, IT, and executive stakeholders to operationalize company strategy and improve GTM performance.

lists.content:
GTM Strategy, Planning & Operating System

  • Lead the end-to-end GTM planning system, including annual and quarterly planning, forecasting, target setting, capacity planning, resource allocation, and performance management.
  • Translate company growth objectives and strategic priorities into aligned GTM targets, resource plans, and execution strategies across functions, segments, regions, and products.
  • Establish and continuously improve GTM operating rhythms, including planning cycles, forecast reviews, executive business reviews, and performance-management processes.
  • Develop scalable planning frameworks, governance models, and operating standards that enable GTM teams to adapt to changing business priorities.
  • Evaluate strategic tradeoffs across GTM investments and develop recommendations regarding capacity, coverage, demand generation, retention, enablement, and other GTM investments.
  • Partner with Finance and GTM leadership on scenario planning, investment decisions, and resource allocation.
    • Business Performance, Analytics & Insights
  • Define performance measurement frameworks that provide consistent visibility into GTM health across the customer lifecycle.
  • Lead the development of analytics and insights that enable GTM leaders to understand performance, identify risks and opportunities, and make informed business decisions.
  • Ensure forecasting, pipeline, funnel, retention, productivity, and other critical GTM performance measures are clearly defined and consistently understood.
  • Translate complex business performance into clear, decision-ready insights and recommendations.
  • Identify emerging performance trends and develop recommendations to improve near- and medium-term GTM effectiveness.
  • Establish priorities for GTM analytics based on business impact and ensure analytical resources are focused on the highest-value questions.

    • GTM Data Strategy & Governance

  • Lead the GTM data strategy and governance function, establishing priorities for the integrity, scalability, and evolution of the GTM data foundation.
  • Ensure consistent GTM business logic, metric definitions, dimensions, and data standards across systems, reporting, and business processes.
  • Establish governance for GTM data definitions, lineage, quality, and usage in partnership with Data, Engineering, IT, Finance, and GTM stakeholders.
  • Ensure GTM business requirements are clearly defined and aligned before technical development begins.
  • Oversee prioritization of GTM data initiatives and make recommendations regarding sequencing, dependencies, business impact, and tradeoffs.
  • Ensure data structures and governed data assets support critical GTM use cases including forecasting, pipeline management, compensation, retention, planning, and performance measurement.
  • Partner with centralized Data and technical organizations to ensure GTM requirements inform technical roadmaps while maintaining clear accountability between business ownership and technical execution.
  • Improve adoption and understanding of governed data assets, metrics, and BI capabilities across GTM.
    • Compensation Strategy & Analytics
  • Lead GTM compensation strategy and planning in partnership with GTM and Finance leadership.
  • Ensure compensation programs align with company objectives, GTM priorities, targets, quotas, and desired business outcomes.
  • Lead compensation modeling and analytics to evaluate program effectiveness, cost, performance, and behavioral impact.
  • Establish governance and decision frameworks for compensation design and changes.
  • Partner with GTM leadership on quota and incentive strategy and provide recommendations regarding tradeoffs and program design.
  • Ensure compensation planning is integrated with broader capacity, target, resource, and financial planning.
    • Strategic Decision Support & Cross-Functional Leadership
  • Serve as a strategic partner to GTM, Finance, Data, IT, and other functional leaders.
  • Structure complex and ambiguous GTM problems, bringing together business context, data, financial implications, and operational considerations.
  • Develop recommendations regarding GTM priorities, investments, organizational tradeoffs, and performance improvement.
  • Lead cross-functional strategic initiatives from problem definition through recommendation and implementation.
  • Collaborate with senior leaders to turn company strategy into actionable GTM plans and ensure alignment across functions.
  • Communicate plans, performance, risks, recommendations, and tradeoffs clearly to senior and executive stakeholders.
    • Leadership & Organizational Development
  • Lead and develop a multidisciplinary organization spanning strategy, planning, analytics, data strategy, and compensation.
  • Translate functional priorities into clear objectives, execution plans, and measurable outcomes.
  • Coach managers and individual contributors toward outcomes, impact, and increasingly strategic thinking.
  • Establish clear accountability and decision rights across the function.
  • Build cross-functional relationships that enable the team to operate effectively across organizational boundaries.
  • Continuously evolve the team's capabilities, processes, and operating model as business needs change.
  • Create clarity around priorities and ensure the organization remains focused on its highest-impact work.

• 12+ years of experience in GTM strategy, business operations, revenue operations, planning, analytics, data strategy, or related functions, preferably within B2B SaaS.
  • 5+ years of people leadership experience, including experience leading managers and/or senior individual contributors.
  • Proven experience leading GTM planning, forecasting, target setting, capacity planning, and performance management.
  • Strong understanding of GTM analytics, SaaS metrics, customer lifecycle performance, and executive decision support.
  • Experience with GTM data strategy, metric governance, data definitions, and the relationship between business requirements and modern data ecosystems.
  • Experience with compensation strategy, quota planning, incentive design, compensation analytics, or closely related planning disciplines.
  • Demonstrated ability to structure ambiguous business problems and translate complex information into actionable recommendations.
  • Strong systems thinking and understanding of dependencies across CRM, data warehouse, BI, planning, and GTM execution environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, Data, IT, and other functions.
  • Strong leadership, communication, prioritization, and judgment.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

salaryDescription:
The pay range for this position is $163,900 to $245,900 for all US locations. This range represents our good faith expectation of what we reasonably expect to pay for this role based on factors including (but not limited to) skills, experience, training, licensure and certifications, education, and other business and organizational needs.
This position is bonus-eligible. Articulate also offers a robust suite of benefits — visit the website for a full list.
 
This is a US-based role and can be performed remotely from anywhere within the United States. Occasional travel for company events may be required. Employees must physically reside and work within the US throughout their employment and must immediately notify Articulate of any change of address.
 
The application window for this position is expected to close 90 days from the original posting date.

descriptionPlain:
We are seeking a Senior Product Marketing Manager to join our Product Marketing team. This role owns the go-to-market (GTM) strategy for one or more products within the Articulate platform, including the GTM plan against revenue goals and the commercial model behind it.
You will shape messaging, pricing and packaging, use funnel data and AI systems to sharpen the plan, and build the launch foundations for execution. You will partner with product, marketing, sales, customer success, growth, ops, and ecosystem and reseller partners to shape the roadmap and carry recommendations to senior leaders. We are looking for someone who writes the playbook, builds the systems the team runs on, and is accountable for the plan that delivers a revenue goal.
description:
We are seeking a Senior Product Marketing Manager to join our Product Marketing team. This role owns the go-to-market (GTM) strategy for one or more products within the Articulate platform, including the GTM plan against revenue goals and the commercial model behind it.

You will shape messaging, pricing and packaging, use funnel data and AI systems to sharpen the plan, and build the launch foundations for execution. You will partner with product, marketing, sales, customer success, growth, ops, and ecosystem and reseller partners to shape the roadmap and carry recommendations to senior leaders. We are looking for someone who writes the playbook, builds the systems the team runs on, and is accountable for the plan that delivers a revenue goal.

lists.content:
• Revenue and GTM plan. Own the GTM plan against the revenue goal for your product(s). Work with Sales and Ops on targets, track progress against them, and decide what to scale, fix, pause or stop as results come in.

  • Commercial model. Shape the pricing, packaging, and monetization approach for your product(s). Make recommendations and carry them through to a decision with cross-functional partners.

  • Shared context and systems. Build and maintain the positioning, messaging, and competitive context, plus the skills and workflows, that the PMM team and its AI agents run on.

  • Funnel data and insights. Own the funnel for your product(s), from first touch through conversion and expansion. Help shape the dashboards and metrics the team relies on, using them to turn insights into GTM strategy and execution.

  • Field readiness. Act as the voice of product, owning field messaging, FAQs, web content, and live enablement for Sales, Customer Success, and reseller partners.

• Build positioning, value propositions, and differentiated messaging for the full buying committee, from practitioners and business creators to administrators and IT stakeholders, and hold a high quality bar on what the team ships

  • Develop deep insight into customers, segments, and target accounts, and use research, usage data, and buying signals to guide GTM plans and the roadmap

  • Build the launch and campaign foundations (plans, templates, assets, standards) that Growth, Content, and Sales execute from

  • Work with Product and Engineering on the roadmap, and make the case for what to build next and how it should be priced and packaged

  • Work with Sales, Customer Success, Legal, and Marketing leadership to reach decisions on commercial strategy that cross teams

  • Adapt GTM across ecosystem, integration, and reseller partners as revenue channels, including positioning, co-marketing, enablement, and shared account plans

  • Build with AI every day - create workflows and agents for your own work, and add to the team's shared context, skills, and agents so everyone's output improves

  • Decide what to do yourself, what to delegate, and what to automate

  • Create internal and field assets, track competitors and market trends, and support events

• 8+ years of product marketing experience, B2B SaaS preferred

  • A track record of owning a GTM plan against a revenue goal or other commercial outcome, and making calls on what to scale, fix, or stop based on data

  • Experience shaping pricing, packaging, and monetization, ideally including usage-based or credit-based models

  • Hands-on AI proficiency to speed up your work and apply your own judgment to the output

  • A high-quality bar for excellent storytelling with the ability to turn complex or technical ideas into a clear narrative that stands out

  • Experience owning a funnel, plus strong comfort with funnel metrics and dashboards used to shape messaging, strategy, and decisions

  • Experience building a launch or GTM framework from a blank page that others then adopted

  • Ability to operate in ambiguity, flex across shifting priorities, and execute in adjacent areas like Growth, Ops and even Sales

  • Experience with ecosystem, integration, or reseller partnerships, ideally as a revenue channel

  • Proven ability to make strategic recommendations to senior leaders and reach a decision

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration across product, sales, customer success, growth, operations, legal, and partners

  • Experience raising the bar for peers through templates, standards, or coaching

  • Bachelor's degree, or equivalent experience, MBA preferred

  • Nice to have: experience with e-learning creation or delivery tools, including Articulate 360
